catalog.title: Gemmascope
catalog.mac: Data → Concepts & Vectors → Import an SAE feature; Analysis → Compare with Gemma Scope features. Custom artifact files: use the file-import button in the J-lens or SAE dialog; both clients expose science artifact-plan and artifact-import.
catalog.http: GET /api/gemmascope/info; POST /api/gemmascope/run; POST /api/gemmascope/import; POST /api/gemmascope/import-id; GET /api/gemmascope/resolve-feature; POST /api/artifact-imports/plan; POST /api/artifact-imports/import
outputs: See the selected operation public response and immutable artifact records.
catalog.restriction: Existing Gemma Scope workbench; preserve import convention and qualification.
